messages:
Diego Ramos: Hey all  first day and hitting a kube access snag. I can see contexts (`kubectl config get-contexts`) but `kubectl get ns` returns `Error from server (Forbidden)`. My context shows `redwood-dev/diego`. Who do I ping for RBAC and what's the onboarding namespace convention? :wave:

Maya (infra): welcome Diego! We spin up per-person namespaces named `onboard-<first>` or `dev-<first>`. Do you need to deploy and port-forward, or just read access? I can create a temporary serviceaccount + RoleBinding (12-24h).

Diego Ramos: Need to deploy a tiny app and port-forward to test local integration, so edit-level perms would be great for today. Also curious how this maps to my kubeconfig  I see two user entries.

Maya (infra): OK created `dev-diego` namespace and serviceaccount `sa/diego-onboard`. Bound to `edit` role for 24h. Try these steps: 

```
# switch context and namespace
kubectl config use-context redwood-dev/diego
kubectl config set-context --current --namespace=dev-diego
# verify RBAC
kubectl auth can-i create deployments
kubectl get pods
```

If `kubectl auth can-i` is "yes" you should be able to deploy. The kubeconfig user entries are fine  infra binds by your GitHub SSO identity, not editing your local kubeconfig.

Diego Ramos: Ran those, `kubectl auth can-i create deployments` -> yes, and `kubectl get pods` shows none (expected). Deploying now. Quick port-forward Q: svc is `my-svc` targetPort 8080, I want localhost:3000.

Tasha - DevEx: run `kubectl port-forward svc/my-svc 3000:8080 -n dev-diego`. Pro tip: set namespace on the context so you can omit `-n`: `kubectl config set-context --current --namespace=dev-diego`. Also add `alias k=kubectl` in your shell rc.

Maya (infra): small note: the binding expires in 24h. If you need an extension for continuing dev work, file an infra-support ticket with your manager's approval. Cluster-admin or cluster-scoped perms require security review.

cluster-bot: Temporary RoleBinding created: `rb-dev-diego` for user Diego Ramos in namespace `dev-diego`. Expires in 24h. For extensions open: https://redwood/intra/support and tag `kube-onboard`.

Diego Ramos: Port-forward working, and logs look good. Thanks everyone  appreciate the fast help! :tada:
